name: vawe
usage: Each item installs as a LAYER OBJECT, not a file: append item.install.layer to the "layers" array of a scene JSON ({"module":"scene",…}), set x/y/start/dur, then `make expand`. Items with a files[] entry also ship a pre-expanded standalone scene that renders without the block library.

items.name: cardCascade
items.description: Show the feature set as cards that pop in one after another under a kinetic title.

items.name: chipGrid
items.description: List the named things as mono pills that pop in staggered, with an accent footer.

items.name: ctaEnd
items.description: End on a held card: the mark, the install line, the url, and no exit.

items.name: echoRing
items.description: Keep the frame alive through the slow change: a stroked ring replays the subject's path one beat late, fading as it grows.

items.name: focusRack
items.description: Rack the focus between two planes: the near one pulls sharp while the far one blurs AND dims, one exchange, then settle sharp before the cut.

items.name: kineticHook
items.description: Open on a kinetic hook: eyebrow, one hero number or word that counts up, a subline that arrives word by word.

items.name: logoLockup
items.description: Lock up the brand: the mark pops, the wordmark travels in, a kinetic headline over a sub.

items.name: logoReveal
items.description: Reveal the brand by DRAWING the mark on stroke by stroke, bloom, then cascade the wordmark.

items.name: morphButton
items.description: Make the button BECOME the next thing: it shrinks, rounds and sheds its label until it is a dot.

items.name: propSentence
items.description: Write one sentence across the frame with real objects as the nouns: word, photo, chip, card, word, on a rolling stagger.

items.name: recordedPan
items.description: Pan a surface wider than the frame on an irregular linear track so it reads as a screen recording, with the cursor and callouts welded to it.

items.name: screenDive
items.description: Push the camera into the real product surface under a kinetic title.

items.name: scrollStory
items.description: Scroll a page taller than the frame the way a person scrolls it: hold the frame still, lean the surface on a static tilt, and stop at each real section in turn on one ease.

items.name: slotSwap
items.description: Fix a row of slots and turn its contents over N times at the same offsets. The right slot changes TYPE each pass so it never reads as a table.

items.name: statReveal
items.description: Land the payoff as a hero stat that counts up under a kinetic label, and hold it.

items.name: terminalReveal
items.description: Show it working in a terminal: the command types itself, output rises, the result lands in the accent.

items.name: typedHook
items.description: Open with a line that types itself in and then UN-types faster than it arrived. It never fades.

items.name: verdictProof
items.description: Prove the claim: type the command, note the result, pop a tone-coloured verdict chip after it.

items.name: wordBlast
items.description: Punctuate with one word (or the mark) that arrives oversized, settles, creeps, then grows THROUGH the frame. It does not fade.
